excluded_batch.reason: cohort classification at final active cycle omitted one Sparse completion

statistical_method: Seed/run unit; 10,000 keyed percentile-bootstrap resamples; pointwise 95% intervals. No intervals for five-seed exploration.
pairing: Finite comparisons share seed and generator configuration; Sparse generation stops at Heavy completion, so observed trace hashes can differ with completion time.

metric_scope.sparse_p99: Within each run, pooled Sparse generation-to-fire nearest-rank P99, including generation-cohort completions during drain; aggregate is the mean of run P99s.
metric_scope.heavy_wall_gap_max: Within each active phase, maximum FIFO-nonempty inter-service wall-cycle gap; includes sink stalls, excludes initial/empty/censored intervals; aggregate is the mean of run maxima.
metric_scope.heavy_completion_delta_cycles: Heavy last-fire cycle in mixed minus isolated; inclusive active-cycle differences agree. Not memory completion or application slowdown.
metric_scope.fairness: Active phase before drain; three mixed lanes have one Sparse request outstanding at cutoff. Generation-cohort waiting includes later drain completions.
metric_scope.classifier: All eighty lanes cross one boundary to B_H/H/H/H and retain effective High for every source.
metric_scope.readiness: Both exploration schedules have nominal 75% availability; realized Bernoulli rates vary by seed and phase.

conditions.finite: N4 D16 W5M; 5M Heavy work; Heavy p=.8, each Sparse p=.02, ready p=.9; one class boundary, B_H/H/H/H, all effective High.
conditions.performance: N4 D16 W5M; 10M training; CGOF2 only; A independent arrivals, B bursts; always-ready 20 seeds529-548, readiness exploration5 seeds509-513.

historical_policy: Historical generators/pins/products preserved; mutable legacy evidence was not regenerated.
